title: Rocky adopts plain-internal-agent practices
summary: Engineering practices from the work agent applied to Rocky: fast Slack acks, tests, linting and a proper reply pipeline.

sections.heading: Improved
items: Async ack: a fast Slack handler verifies and acks within Slack's 3 second window, then hands off to an async worker via fire and forget Lambda invoke
Bot user id cached per cold start instead of one auth.test per event
Markdown to Slack mrkdwn converter for agent replies
Biome lint and format plus a Vitest suite covering signature verification, prompt building and memory trimming

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Dead TMDB config wired to a real secret so movie tools register
Numeric tool args accepted as number or string
